text:
Type: woven tasseled throw cushion
Use: accent seating comfort, on a sofa or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, rustic, modern
Materials: chunky handwoven cotton blend, cotton tassels
Colors: heathered grey, cream white
Shape: square, central diamond pattern outlined by eight cream tassels, nubby striped weave, knife edges, medium size
Feel: textured, cozy, crafted
Goes with: natural wood, rattan, linen, white walls; bohemian, Scandinavian or modern farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Tassel Diamond Throw Pillow - 18 x 18 Inch, Black / White
product.description: The variegated black yarn of this modern throw pillow accentuates the stripes of the white-and-black diamond in its center, surrounded by soft white tassels for added flair and style. Cotton/polyester Imported 18"L x 18"W Handwoven and hand-stitched tassels are an added detail that make this pillow truly special. The space-dyed yarn means the color variations are soft and muted. 1 throw pillow Spot clean with a damp cloth, and then allow to air dry. Rather than pulling at any loose threads, please use scissors to trim them.
